prompt:
Design a desktop website landing screen, 16:9 landscape (1920x1080), rendered as the web page itself edge to edge (no browser window, no device frame, no mockup).

Brand: ROOMi (ROOMiVERSE), a DJ lifestyle brand that turns any ordinary room into your own party; the name means "Room + Universe". Use the attached image as the logo: a hand-drawn black marker graffiti wordmark "ROOMi" (render it in white where it sits on dark).

The whole site is art-directed as a mini CD single release package (early-2000s Japanese mini CD single: jewel case, OBI paper strip, screen-printed disc, lyric booklet). This screen is the CD's front cover.

Regions, in order:
1. Top navigation bar, thin, full width. The ROOMi graffiti logo sits at the exact horizontal center. Left side: "Meet ROOMi", "What's Going On", "Let's Party", "Shop". Right side: "Cart (0)", "My". Small clean sans-serif, uppercase, white.
2. Full-bleed cover art filling the whole screen behind everything: a container port at dusk, photographed like an album cover. Stacked shipping containers, one gantry crane silhouette, wet concrete apron. Color-graded in the brand palette: hot pink #F71D64 and violet #C14ED4 light in the sky, soft peach #FFB792 haze on the horizon, deep black #111111 shadows. Over the whole image, a subtle polycarbonate jewel-case sheen: faint diagonal reflection, the hairline hinge edge visible along the left side.
3. A vertical OBI strip running the full height on the right edge, about 13% of the screen width, printed paper in light gray #F0F0F0 with black type. Top to bottom it carries: small "ROOMiVERSE" in widely tracked caps, a large vertical "ROOMi" title, Korean line "내 방안의 나만의 우주", then a numbered tracklist "01 House Party / 02 Listening Party / 03 Day Party / 04 Themed Party / 05 Rave Party / 06 After Party", and at the bottom a hot pink #F71D64 block with a play-triangle and the word "PLAY".
4. Bottom-left corner, small: catalog number "RMV-001" and "Enter the container" in small caps.

One dominant move: the cover photograph plus the OBI strip. Everything else is quiet. Typography: one crisp grotesk sans for UI, condensed bold for the vertical title. Body text at real reading size. No extra badges, no stock UI cards, no fake prices, no neon glow outlines.
